_comment: One section per platform. Kara reads the one for the machine it is running on, and refuses a download that identifies as the other platform even if this file points at the wrong one.
DO NOT add a top-level version/url. Builds older than 1.58 read a flat manifest and have no platform check, so a flat entry would hand them whichever operating system's zip it named.

windows.notes: Self-updating is back on, and now knows which platform it is.
